title: Docs: Alpha OS Project Knowledge System v1
body:
## Purpose
Codex-prepared project knowledge system: AGENTS.md, docs/alpha-os-knowledge/, source-linked research catalogue, append-only decisions and backtests, read-only validation.

## Review checklist
- Verify references and status of PR #1–13 against GitHub.
- Confirm historical results and licensing/privacy claims against primary evidence.
- Run `python scripts/validate_project_knowledge.py` and CI checks; examine any warnings.
- Ensure no production/runtime, trading, purchasing, or deployment changes.
- Verify documentation update rules are feasible and do not misstate automation.

## Safety
Draft for human review only. Do not merge or deploy automatically. This PR does not implement a ChatGPT–Notion automatic sync.
head: docs/project-knowledge-system-v1
